selection: Provisional visual-analysis scope increased at the user's request after inspecting the 16/8 gallery. Prior results were already exposed. Not a blind evaluation, proven detectability limit or operating acceptance threshold.
distance_policy: No guessed metric distance cutoff; use source-image box size consistently across models.
prediction_policy: Match main GT first. Only unmatched predictions mostly within ignored GT can be ignored; do not globally drop small predictions.
training_policy: Preserve all original GT. Evaluation ignore is not a YOLO TXT training ignore flag. Do not delete tiny positive labels or convert tiny-only images into negatives.
